title: Storm & Candido win together, then fall apart
summary: Lance Storm and Chris Candido become champions despite personal friction. Once the partnership breaks down, their competition moves from the tag division into singles matches.

chapters.title: The uneasy partners become champions
chapters.result: Storm and Candido win the three-way tag-title match.
chapters.context: Their championship success does not remove the tension between them.

chapters.title: Candido wins the singles showdown
chapters.context: After losing the belts and separating, the former partners settle part of their dispute directly.
